negative_knowledge: Tests that hand-build an SDK client must return compat.Response, not httpx.Response, or the request escapes to the real network on httpx2-based SDKs
Never simulate a missing optional dependency by reloading a module in-process; the state is shared and the simulation is often impossible in reality. Use a subprocess.
gifsicle -O2 merges identical frames and destroys a fixed-frame-count GIF; -O1 is safe and must be verified pixel-identical
PIL's GIF writer merges identical consecutive frames, destroying frame counts; hand-written encoders are required for exact contracts
httpx.Client/AsyncClient require __enter__/__exit__/__aenter__/__aexit__ on a transport, so a duck-typed transport must implement the context-manager protocol by delegating to the inner transport

anthropic 0.116.0 rebinds httpx.BaseTransport (and httpx._transports.base.BaseTransport) to its own class on import. Never subclass or isinstance-check httpx transport bases; never rely on import order to pin them.
The session registry holds WEAK references, so a test that needs two live sessions must keep both states bound to a variable or they are collected immediately
context_summary: Goal: zero open defects across backstop and backinstop. Iteration 0: surveyed both repos. Confirmed: transport subclasses httpx.BaseTransport directly (single-family) while internals are _httpcompat-aware; CI has no lint step and no TypeScript job; ts/backstop/src/audit.ts uses require() inside an ESM package; package-lock.json still says @ravanish/backstop@0.5.0 vs package.json backstop-ai@0.6.0; 32 ruff findings; budgets = get_ledger() goes stale after reset_ledger(); planning risk rows O20/O21/O24 are resolved but still listed as open; CHANGELOG has no entry for this session's fixes; marketing site has no demo.gif, no *.tsbuildinfo gitignore, and an unsubstantiated 'Compliant with SOC2 Type II, HIPAA' claim. | T1 done: transports are now duck-typed (no httpx base), because anthropic 0.116.0 rebinds httpx.BaseTransport at import time so class identity is unstable; also fixed _sync/_async_transport_from which isinstance-checked those bases and silently discarded the SDK's own transport. Verified: main env 1214 pass, httpx2 env end-to-end OK, anthropic-patch scenario immune. The 2 failures in the throwaway httpx2 venv are pre-existing (no anthropic installed) and fail identically without this change. | T2 done: backstop.budgets now resolves via module __getattr__ so it cannot go stale after reset_ledger(). T3 done: ruff clean across src+tests (was 35). Along the way fixed a real F821 (Any unimported, my own regression), a duplicate statistics import, four vestigial bindings in cli.py where the CALL is the smoke test, and made test_budget_spent_plus_reserved_never_exceeds_total actually assert the invariant it was named for (it built a violations list and never checked it - the Step 0 audit's 'vacuous test'). 1216 passed. | T4 done: audit.ts used require('node:fs') inside a "type": "module" package, so every file-path audit sink threw ReferenceError at construction; replaced with a static import and added a real filesystem test (18 TS tests now). Regenerated package-lock.json which still said @ravanish/backstop@0.5.0 vs package.json backstop-ai@0.6.0. T5 done: CI now runs ruff check in the matrix job (ruff added to the test extra) and a new ts-backstop job runs lockfile-identity check + npm ci + typecheck + build + test on Node 22. | T6 done: O1 was REAL and is now fixed (frozen-dataclass assignment now uses object.__setattr__, and only builds a chain when virtual_keys exist - there is nothing to resolve otherwise). Also found O1b: secrets.py documented env-before-virtual_keys while the code and its tests did the opposite; corrected the docstring to the shipped, tested order rather than changing behaviour. docs/install.md O22 corrected, TODO.md completed, and the risk register now re-verifies every row against the code and marks status instead of deleting history. | T7 done: CHANGELOG now records the secret-provider fix, the transport-reuse fix, the TS ESM fix, both CI test fixes, the vacuous stress test, the budgets alias, the duck-typed transport change, and the GIF optimisation with its proof.
